purpose: Teach: 国費/楽勝/解法/在職/使い物/引換/節減/棄権

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、国費で行く海外学会に挑め
lines.en: Ren, go for that overseas conference. The one funded by the state.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Eyes steady on him. Spoken as simple fact, not question. A gate opening, not a push.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。今回の発表は楽勝でした
lines.style: Quick agreement, no embellishment. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Brief and earnest — he means it, not overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の解法を分かりやすく書け
lines.en: Ren, make sure your paper's methodology is clear to readers.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Each syllable distinct. Eyes moving to the next task. Practical expectation, not criticism.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。在職中の教授に推薦を頼みました
lines.en: Yes. I've already asked a professor from my current position for a recommendation letter.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Measured pace. Shows he's already thinking ahead without being told. No rushing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データが使い物にならないなら採集し直せ
lines.en: Ren, if that data won't hold up, collect it again.
lines.style: Serious drop in tone. Slow, deliberate. No room for cutting corners. The weight of integrity in four words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。図書券の引換にも気を付けます
lines.en: Yes. I'll be careful with every expense too — even small things like book vouchers.
lines.style: Earnest and attentive. Shows he understands the principle behind the rule, not just the rule. Steady, no defensive edge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の節減を意識しろ
lines.en: Ren, stay conscious of your research budget. Every decision counts.
lines.style: Final instruction, slightly softer than the data one. Expectation of maturity. Leans back slightly — this one settles the conversation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の投票では棄権せず意思表示します
lines.en: Yes. At the conference vote, I won't abstain. I'll make my position clear.
lines.style: Quiet conclusion. Understands the deeper point — intellectual responsibility, not just box-checking. Small breath before the period.
